<div class="card-body">
'''Blaster Rack''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ブラスター収納ラック</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">場の自分の側に配備する。好きなロケーションにいるキャラクターの持つ武器を１つ、ブラスター収納ラックの上に移すことができる。配備フェイズに、武器の配備コストを支払いなおせば、その武器を任意のキャラクターに配備することができる。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デス・スターや帝国軍守備隊基地の補給所には、ブラスター収納ラックがある。ブラスター・ライフルやサーマル・デトネーター（高温弾）など、兵士用の装備が立てかけてある。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Blaster storage rack.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on your side of the table. You may move one weapon held by a character at any location onto the Blaster Rack. During the deploy phase, if you pay the weapon's deploy cost again, you may deploy that weapon on any character.

'''Lore:''' Supply stations on the Death Star and at Imperial garrison bases have blaster storage racks. Equipment for soldiers, such as blaster rifles and thermal detonators, is stored on them.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a weapon held by a character at any location and does not explicitly say it must be yours or specify that the move may be made at any time. The English refers to one of your character weapons at any site and explicitly allows the move at any time. The Japanese says the weapon may be deployed on any character.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Blaster Rack]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=40s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 0:40.</ref>
